money_market.source: WIBOR fixings of 14 Apr 2026 (GPW Benchmark delayed data); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 14 Apr 2026. Funding = nominal-weighted special repo starting within one day, <= 3 days (3.60%).

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR at the 14 Apr 2026 close: LSEG end-of-day interbank bid rates in the Erste Bank Polska Codziennik of 15 Apr 2026 (table headed 14.04.2026; only the 14 Apr 2026 levels are used). Bid side, so roughly 1-2bp below mid. 7Y not available. PCHIP interpolation through 6M WIBOR and the pillars; beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS at the 14 Apr 2026 close (LSEG bid via Erste), WIBOR fixings 14 Apr 2026

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 14 Apr 2026; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.33% = average of sub-1Y fixed POLGB yields (DS0726 3.18%, PS1026 3.38%, OK0127 3.43%).

portfolio_meta._source: GPW Benchmark 'Portfele obligacji' communique for the periodic change of 31 Mar 2026 (holdings and statistics as of 26 Mar 2026; announced 27 Mar 2026 per the GPWB index calendar; the served PDF was regenerated 30 Mar 2026 11:22 CEST). PS1026 leaves TBSP (18 -> 17 bonds); no other membership changes; units reflect trades through the 25 Mar auction (OK0127 reduced by the 18 Mar buyback; OK0128, DS1035, DS0432, PS0131 increased).
